text: Implemented CRQA with retained recurrence matrix; typed embedding dimension, delay, inclusive fixed and target-rate radius selection, diagonal/laminar line minima, and explicit laminar axis; computes RR, DET, LAM, diagonal ENTR in nats, TT, and L_max. Analytic matrix oracles, edge cases, metamorphic translation, JVM/JS coverage, and a killed ignored-delay mutant verify parameter wiring.
